question: Who just got arrested inside Kim Kardashian's empty mansion?
story: Someone broke into Kim Kardashian's sixty million dollar mansion, and then reportedly stole a car out of the driveway and took it for a joyride. According to NBC News and TMZ, a twenty seven year old man showed up at her Hidden Hills estate on Sunday afternoon and forced his way in through a side door. Here is the thing. Kim does not even live there right now. The house is in the middle of a renovation, so she and her four kids have been staying somewhere else. Security guards reportedly spotted him loading items into a vehicle and called police, who arrested him on the property. He is being held on suspicion of burglary and taking a vehicle without the owner's consent. Prosecutors have not formally filed charges yet, and the case reportedly goes to the Los Angeles County District Attorney for review. A sixty million dollar house, and the car was the part he could not resist.
